title: User Profile
description: Per-player profile. Persisted in user_profile table. One row per player_id.

id.description: Player identifier from X-Player-Id header. Same as player_id PK.

displayName.description: User-chosen display name. Trimmed before storage.

streakDays.description: Consecutive-day scan streak. Resets on missed day.

activeCharacterId.description: Currently equipped character id, or null if none.

colorMode.description: How the accent color is sourced. Mirrors ColorMode in DesignTokens.swift.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601. Set once on first GET /user/:id.
